CustomField.description: When checked, the email alert is sent to the owner of the record under approval (the OwnerId field on the target object). Used only when ActionKind__c = EmailAlert.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Sends to the user in the OwnerId field of the target record. If the record is owned by a queue, the queue members are resolved and notified individually.
CustomField.label: Notify Record Owner
